proposals.name: Ham Radio Operators & SWL (Radioamateurs)
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-oriented hobbyists, often 40-70 years old, highly meticulous, proud of their call signs, who love logging contacts and displaying technical reference charts in their radio shacks.
product_angles: Printable QSL Card templates (fully customizable SVG/Canva links)
DX Contact Logbooks and ITU zone tracking journals (Amazon KDP)
Ham Radio Cheat Sheets, frequency allocation wall art poster files
proposals.first_test_product: A minimalist, high-density Radio Contact Log Book for Amazon KDP with a premium retro technical cover design

proposals.name: Solo TTRPG (Solo Roleplaying Games)
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie tabletop gamers who play alone. They require journaling templates, minimalist oracle cards, and random table generators to drive their narrative without a Dungeon Master.
product_angles: Solo RPG Campaign Journal & World-building templates (KDP)
Printable Oracle Cards / Spark Tables (The Game Crafter / PDF download)
Hex-crawl map builder SVGs & minimalist fantasy map-making assets
proposals.first_test_product: A 120-page 'Solo RPG Journaling Companion' with built-in minimalist dungeon-generation tables on KDP

proposals.name: HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts / AMHE)
proposals.buyer_persona: Martial artists practicing historical European combat (longsword, rapier). They are highly dedicated, value historical accuracy, and love displaying fencing-themed insider gear.
product_angles: HEMA Sparring and Technique Training Diaries (KDP)
Historical fencing vector graphics (SVG) for club t-shirts and gear customisation
Minimalist technical weapon maintenance logs and tournament brackets
proposals.first_test_product: An SVG graphic pack featuring accurate historical longsword guards (Liechtenauer / Fiore) for print-on-demand customisation

proposals.name: Homebrewers & Small Craft Breweries (Micro-brasseries)
proposals.buyer_persona: Homebrewing enthusiasts and local nano-breweries who need professional, clean, yet affordable branding assets, label layouts, and batch tracking organizers.
product_angles: Homebrew Recipe Logbooks with gravity-to-ABV conversion charts (KDP)
Editable beer bottle labels (Canva/SVG templates sold on Etsy)
Brewery batch record sheets and cellar logs for tiny commercial setups
proposals.first_test_product: The 'Ultimate Homebrewer's Recipe & Batch Logbook' on Amazon KDP with a clean, modern grid interior

proposals.name: Godot 4 2D Indie Game UI/UX Themes
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo indie game developers using Godot 4 who lack graphic design skills but want professional, cohesive, and drag-and-drop UI templates for their RPGs or Platformers.
product_angles: Minimalist flat UI vector icons (SVG packs optimized for retro/cyberpunk themes)
Godot-native '.tres' UI theme presets with pre-configured button states
Low-poly or pixel-art inventory grid layouts and UI framing vectors
proposals.first_test_product: A 'Minimalist Sci-Fi UI Vector Kit' containing 150+ clean SVG icons and panels for Godot 2D games

proposals.name: Cave Explorers (Speleology / Spéléologie)
proposals.buyer_persona: Cave explorers, vertical caving enthusiasts, and surveyors who require extremely rugged, structured logbooks for subterranean expeditions and mapping.
product_angles: Cave Surveying & Sketching Field Books (KDP, with grid/polar coordinate pages)
Caving trip planning journals with gear checklists and vertical rigging logs
Minimalist cave mapping iconography and technical SVG vector packs
proposals.first_test_product: A specialized 'Cave Expedition Log & Survey Sketchbook' featuring cross-section graph papers
